summary: This is an HTML comment block at the top of a documentation file that explains the file was auto-generated and tells developers how to update it. It serves as a header for a documentation index that lists available helper modules.

explanations.1: The `<!--` opens an HTML comment block so the text inside won't display in browsers.
explanations.3: This tells developers they need to run a shell script called generate_doc.sh if they make changes and want to regenerate this documentation.
explanations.5: This is a placeholder for when the documentation was last updated, though it shows 'xxx' meaning it hasn't been filled in yet.
